title: Fabrizio Castania
summary:
Fabrizio Castania is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the Huntik: Secrets & Seekers soundtrack, including the songs Huntik Go and Heroes and Titans which were released commercially in 2010. 

He has worked alongside Michele Bettali and Stefano Carrara on many different projects, including Huntiks sister show, Winx Club.

raw_wikitext:
'''Fabrizio Castania''' is an Italian musician and one of the three composers of the ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'' soundtrack, including the songs ''[[Huntik Go]]'' and ''[[Heroes and Titans]]'' which were released commercially in 2010. 

He has worked alongside [[Michele Bettali]] and [[Stefano Carrara]] on many different projects, including ''Huntik'''s sister show, ''Winx Club''.
